::: {.hero-code}
```{.groovy code-line-numbers="true"}
plugins {
    id 'ch.so.agi.gretl'
}

import ch.so.agi.gretl.tasks.DuckDbSqlExecutor

tasks.register('analyse', DuckDbSqlExecutor) {
    database file('build/work.duckdb')
    sqlFiles 'sql/analyse.sql'
}
```
